quote: Most people carry sorrows you will never understand. You walk through rooms filled with quiet pain. Everyone is fighting to keep their pieces together. A heavy heart hides behind a gentle smile. You must learn to love people without knowing everything. Sometimes just staying alive is enough of a victory. Be the quiet comfort someone desperately needs today.
